title: Regolith Lander
tagline: A lunar descent in 95 printable characters
description: Land on the pads at eight lunar sites. Blast basalt with rockets to free glowing He-3 crystals, topple lamp posts or bring the x3 roof down. Touch down under 1 m/s for a bonus; above about 4 m/s the legs collapse.
head: head.html
controls: fire a rocket (aim with the mouse)

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Lunar gravity is 1.62. Everything falls with it: the lander, grains, debris and boulders.

thrust.label: Engine thrust
thrust.help: Descent engine acceleration at full throttle, as a multiple of gravity.

fuelSeconds.label: Fuel
fuelSeconds.help: Seconds of full-throttle burn on the first site (later sites get up to 10 s less).

rockets.label: Rockets
rockets.help: Rockets at the start of a site (later sites add up to 5).

blastRadius.label: Rocket blast radius
blastRadius.help: How much rock a rocket carves out (1 base unit = 0.5 m).

meteors.label: Meteor showers
meteors.help: Multiplier on the meteor rate from site 2 on; 0 turns showers off.

startSite.label: Start at site
startSite.help: Site a new mission starts on.
